# Software versions

```{r book_provenance, echo=FALSE}
# Book version (from the YAML metadata) and the last git commit of the source
# tree the PDF was built from. The git lookup falls back to "unknown" if the
# build happens outside a git repository (e.g. from a release source tarball).
book_version <- rmarkdown::metadata$version
git_field <- function(fmt) {
  out <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(system2("git", c("log", "-1", "--date=short", paste0("--format=", fmt)),
                             stdout = TRUE, stderr = FALSE)),
    error = function(e) character(0))
  if (length(out) == 0 || !nzchar(out[1])) NA_character_ else out[1]
}
git_hash <- git_field("%h")
git_date <- git_field("%cd")
git_commit <- if (is.na(git_hash)) {
  "unknown"
} else if (is.na(git_date)) {
  git_hash
} else {
  paste0(git_hash, " (", git_date, ")")
}
```

This book, version `r book_version`, was rendered from the source code on `r format(Sys.time(), "%b %d, %Y at %X")`, at git commit `r git_commit`, with the following R package versions.

```{r session_summary, echo=FALSE, comment=NA}
  # sessionInfo() prints the BLAS/LAPACK library paths with cat(), so those
  # lines ignore options(width) and can run past the right trim edge in the
  # PDF (the LAPACK path is a single unbreakable token, so word wrapping will
  # not split it). Hard-wrap every output line to the code-column width so no
  # line is clipped, whatever the build machine's library paths happen to be.
  code_width <- 60
  options(width = code_width)
  info <- capture.output(sessionInfo())
  wrapped <- unlist(lapply(info, function(line) {
    if (nchar(line) <= code_width) return(line)
    starts <- seq(1, nchar(line), by = code_width)
    substring(line, starts, pmin(starts + code_width - 1, nchar(line)))
  }))
  cat(wrapped, sep = "\n")
```
